Vorro DataHub
The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why now

Tennr's RaeLM model reads referrals and routes them across more than 150 healthcare organizations, each with its own fax gateway, EHR and intake systems that the platform has to reconcile.

Even where each partner organization's own systems look tidy on paper, Vorro's job is making sure every one of them agrees on the same referral and patient record.

The payoff is concrete: one integration layer retires the redundant interfaces and manual data movement that quietly drain the budget, streamlining operations and taking roughly 35% out of what an AI health tech company Tennr's size spends on technology.
